# Functions 
```{r}
# Functions limits and breaks
fun_breaks <- function(x) {
  if (max(x) > 2) {
    if (((ceiling(max(x)) - floor(min(x))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)), length.out = 3)
    } else {
      seq(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)+1), length.out = 3)
    }
  } else {
    if (((ceiling(max(x*10)) - floor(min(x*10))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      seq(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)), length.out = 3)/10
    } else {
      seq(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)+1), length.out = 3)/10
    }
  }
}
fun_limits <- function(x) {
  if (max(x) > 2) {
    if (((ceiling(max(x)) - floor(min(x))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      c(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)))
    } else {
      c(floor(min(x)), ceiling(max(x)+1))
    }
  }  else {
    if (((ceiling(max(x*10)) - floor(min(x*10))) %% 2) == 0) { # Check if even or odd
      c(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)))/10
    } else {
      c(floor(min(x*10)), ceiling(max(x*10)+1))/10
    }
  }
}
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
selpat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "multi_mmr", "multi_dtp", "pn", "hib", 
              "multi_men", "hbv", "multi_ipv")

# Select a cluster 
clu_name <- "reg_3"
clu_name_val <- "1_Temperate"

# Read models for a single clustering method
mod_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  if(x %in% c("varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "multi_mmr")) {vac <- "v1"
  } else {vac <- "vl"}
  if(str_detect(x, "multi")) {gauss <- "_gauss"
  } else {gauss <- ""}
  list(reg = summary(readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/bm{vac}_s08_{x}_csi_{clu_name}{gauss}.rds"))),
       base = summary(readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/bm{vac}_s08_{x}_base{gauss}.rds"))))
  }, simplify = FALSE)

mod_l$multi_men$reg <- summary(readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/multi_men/bmvl_s08_multi_men_cs_gauss.rds")))
mod_l$multi_ipv$reg <- summary(readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/multi_ipv/bmvl_s08_multi_ipv_cs_gauss.rds")))

modsum_l <- unlist(mod_l, recursive = FALSE)

x <- modsum_l$rota.reg

# Tidy data frame for all 
df_fixed <- sapply(modsum_l, function(x) {
  x$fixed %>%
    rownames_to_column("param") %>%
    filter(str_detect(param, "age|sex|vac_conc|time_v1_v2|time_v2_v3|time_vl_s1"))}, 
  simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pathogen") %>%
  separate(pathogen, into = c("pathogen", "mod"), sep = "\\.") %>%
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(param, "(?<=immvals1anti).+?(?=_)"), 
         param = case_when(
           str_detect(pathogen, "multi") ~ str_extract(param, "(?<=_).+"),
           .default = param),
         param = str_remove(param, "_")) %>%
  relocate(pathogen, imm_name, mod, param)


pl_fixed <- df_fixed %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l),
         imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, " "),
         imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = imm_name, color = mod)) + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_segment(aes(x = `l-95% CI`, xend = `u-95% CI`, yend = imm_name)) + 
  facet_grid(pathogen+imm_name~param, scales = "free", switch = "y") + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0))

ggsave(pl_fixed, file = "outputs/figures/all_asel_covars.pdf",
       height = 4, width = 15)

df_fixed %>%
  filter(param == "age") %>%
  filter(pathogen == "pn")
```

# Per covariate, tidy
```{r}
pat_tidy_names <- c("Rotavirus", "Varicella zoster virus", "Measles virus", "Mumps virus", 
              "Rubella virus", "C. diphtheriae", "C. tetani", "B. pertussis", 
              "S. pneumoniae", "H. influenzae Type B", 
              "N. meningitidis \n (serotypes c and a)", "Hepatitis B virus",
              "Polio virus \n (serotypes 1, 2 and 3)")
names(pat_tidy_names) <- c("rota", "varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "dipht", "tetan", 
                     "pertupt", "pn", "hib", "multi_men", "hbv","multi_ipv") 

pl_age <- df_fixed %>%
  filter(param == "age")  %>%
  mutate(imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""), 
         sam_imm = paste0(pathogen,imm_name), 
         pat_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtp") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = pathogen),
         pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy,  levels = names(pat_tidy_names), labels = pat_tidy_names),
         imm_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_men", "multi_ipv") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = NA)) %>%
  filter(mod == "reg") %>%
  #filter(imm_name != "menc") %>%
  mutate(effect_cuali = case_when(`l-95% CI` < 0 & `u-95% CI` < 0 ~ "negative",
                                  `l-95% CI` > 0 & `u-95% CI` > 0 ~ "positive",
                                  .default = "nonsig")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = reorder(pat_tidy, Estimate), color = effect_cuali)) + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_segment(aes(x = `l-95% CI`, xend = `u-95% CI`, yend = pat_tidy), alpha = 0.8) + 
    geom_point(size = 4, color = "white") + 
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "grey", "#0D0887FF")) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Estimated effect of age at vaccination") + 
  theme(#axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "none")

ggsave(pl_age, file = glue("outputs/figures/covars_age.pdf"), height = 3, width = 6)
```

```{r}
bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  filter(age < 52*4) %>%
  mutate(imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_|_"),
         imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""), 
         sam_imm = paste0(pathogen,imm_name), 
         pat_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtp") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = pathogen),
         pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy,  levels = names(pat_tidy_names), labels = pat_tidy_names),
         imm_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_men", "multi_ipv") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = NA)) %>%
  filter(!(pathogen %in% c("multi_mmr", "varicella"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = age/4, group = imm_name)) + 
    geom_density(fill = "grey", color = "transparent") + 
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.5,1)) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Age (months)") + 
    facet_grid(pat_tidy~., scales = "free") + 
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
```

```{r}
selpat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "multi_mmr", "multi_dtp", "pn", "hib", 
              "multi_men", "hbv", "multi_ipv")

# Read in the data 
dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  if(x %in% c("varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "multi_mmr")) {vac <- "v1"
  } else {vac <- "vl"}
  dat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/data_brms_{x}_{vac}_s08.rds"))
  if(x %in% c("multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv")) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      relocate(imm_val_s1_anti_polio_1, imm_val_s1_anti_polio_2, imm_val_s1_anti_polio_3)
  }
  return(dat)
  }, simplify = FALSE)

datlong_l <- sapply(str_subset(selpat_l, "multi"), function(x) {
  dat_l[[x]] %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(!c(starts_with("censored"), starts_with("imm_val_s0"))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("imm_val_s1"), names_to = "imm_name", values_to = "imm_val_s1",
                 cols_vary = "slowest") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "imm_val_s1_"))}, 
  simplify = FALSE)

datlong_l <- c(datlong_l, dat_l[str_subset(selpat_l, "multi", negate = TRUE)])

pl_age <- (bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  filter(age < 52*4) %>%
    mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l),
           imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, " "),
           imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = age/4, y = log(imm_val_s1))) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Age (months)",
                       trans = "log") + 
    facet_wrap(pathogen + imm_name~., scales = "free")) +
  (bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  filter(age < 52*4) %>%
    mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l),
           imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, " "),
           imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = age/4)) + 
    geom_density() + 
    scale_x_continuous("Age (months)") + 
    facet_grid(pathogen + imm_name~., scales = "free")) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(5,1), ncol = 2)

ggsave(pl_age, file = "outputs/figures/all_asel_covars_age.pdf",
       height = 15, width = 20)

pl_sex <- bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
    mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l),
           imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, " "),
           imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log(imm_val_s1), color = sex, fill = sex)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.1) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
    scale_size_continuous("Individuals", breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + 
    facet_wrap(pathogen + imm_name~., scales = "free") + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") 

ggsave(pl_sex, file = "outputs/figures/all_asel_covars_sex.pdf",
       height = 7, width = 7)

   # filter(str_detect(param, "age|sex|vac_conc|time_v1_v2|time_v2_v3|time_vl_s1"))}, 

pl_vac_conc <- bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(vac_conc = case_when(pathogen == "multi_ipv" ~ NA,
         .default = vac_conc)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vac_conc)) %>%
    mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l),
           imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, " "),
           imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = vac_conc, y = log(imm_val_s1))) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
    facet_wrap(pathogen + imm_name~.)

ggsave(pl_vac_conc, file = "outputs/figures/all_asel_covars_vacconc.pdf",
       height = 7, width = 7)

pl_time <- bind_rows(datlong_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
    mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l),
           imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, " "),
           imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "anti_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(time_v1_v2, time_v2_v3, time_vl_s1)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value/30, y = log(imm_val_s1))) + 
    geom_point(alpha = 0.1) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Ab titers (log)") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Months", trans = "log") + 
    scale_size_continuous("Individuals", breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 150, 200)) + 
    facet_grid(pathogen + imm_name~name, scales = "free") + 
    theme(legend.position = "right") 

ggsave(pl_time, file = "outputs/figures/all_asel_covars_time.pdf",
       height = 20, width = 10)
```
